FY2024 total revenue for GE Aerospace was $38,702 million [DOC: ge_fy2024_income_statement.txt].

On this restated, comparable basis, GE Aerospace's revenue grew from $29,139 million (FY2022, restated) to $38,702 million (FY2024), an increase of approximately 32.8%.

ANSWER: Approximately 32.8% growth (from $29,139M in FY2022 to $38,702M in FY2024, on a continuing-operations basis reflecting the GE HealthCare and GE Vernova spin-offs).
